title: 第314章 大白客气点第313章 借东西
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：749局：我一个邪修考编怎么了第一卷：默认第314章大白，客气点（..la）大白在办公室里跳着脚，指着裴青云那叫一个咬牙切齿。
刚才要不是他反应快，差点一头栽进一个化粪池里。
这简直是鹅生中的奇耻大辱！
看着大白那副快要吃人的模样，躺在沙发上的陈邪不仅没有拦着，反而从沙发上坐直了身体。
“哎哎哎！大白，你这是干什么呢？还有没有点规矩了！”
陈邪挑了挑眉，嘴上虽然说着训斥的话，但语气里却透着不怀好意：“人家裴大部长可是咱们总部的高层，今天大老远跑来，可是专门来跟咱们借东西的。你可得对人家客气点，别失了咱们七处的礼数。”
说着，陈邪还特意对裴青云露出了一个灿烂无比的笑容。
但裴青云看着陈邪这个笑容，心里莫名地“咯噔”了一下，常年在总部摸爬滚打的直觉告诉他，这小子绝对没憋什么好屁。
“嘎？”
大白愣住了，转过头一脸不可思议地看着陈邪。
“你让白爷我对这老狗客气点？！”
大白指着自己的鼻子，气急败坏地叫屈，“他刚才连个招呼都不打就把白爷给扇飞了，白爷没拿加特林突突他就已经是宽宏大量了，还要白爷对他客气？！”
陈邪没搭理大白的抱怨，而是剥了一颗葡萄扔进嘴里，这才悠悠地吐出一句话。
“裴部长，不是小爷我小气不借给你。”
陈邪摊了摊手，满脸无辜地看着裴青云，“而是你要借的那东西，根本就不在小爷身上，那东西……现在在大白身上。而你刚才……”
陈邪拉长了音调，眼神戏谑地看了一眼大白，又看了一眼裴青云。
听到这话，裴青云端着茶杯的手猛地一僵，脸上一直保持的平静终于出现了一丝龟裂。
他有些难以置信地看了看陈邪，又看了看死肥鹅，整个人都无语了。
六欲伞啊！
这么重要、甚至能引起整个修行界血雨腥风的东西，陈邪竟然不随身带着，而是放在了一只天天只知道吃妖丹、满嘴跑火车的流氓鹅身上？！

大白也是一愣，绿豆小眼眨巴了两下。
“嘎？东西？你要借什么东西？”
大白挠了挠脑门，突然想起了什么，“你说的是六欲伞？！”
大白这一声惊呼，直接算是变相承认了六欲伞在它身上。
裴青云的脸色瞬间有些难看了，心里更是把陈邪给骂了一万遍。
他怎么也没想到，自己来借东西，关键竟然卡在了一只鹅身上，而且自己刚刚还手贱把这只鹅给扇飞了！
这下轮到大白爽了！
“嘎嘎嘎！哈哈哈哈！”
大白双手叉腰，仰天发出一阵欠揍的反派怪笑。
他戳了戳裴青云面前的茶几，阴阳怪气地嘲讽起来。
“哟哟哟~原来高高在上的裴大部长，今天是有求于白爷我啊！”
大白脸上写满了小人得志，“姓裴的，你刚才大展神威把白爷扇飞出去的时候，有没有想过会有这样的结局啊？！”
大白昂起下巴：“现在知道来求白爷了？晚了！刚才那股嚣张劲呢？接着扇啊，有本事再扇白爷一个试试啊！”
看着大白这蹬鼻子上脸的模样，裴青云深吸了一口气，强行压下心头想要再次把它扇飞的冲动。
他索性不理会大白的阴阳怪气，转头看向躺在沙发上的陈邪，眉头紧锁地质问道。
“陈邪，你胡闹也要有个限度！那种牵涉极大的重要东西，你怎么能如此草率地让大白拿着？！”
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Bureau 749: What happened to me, an evil cultivator? Volume 1: Default Chapter 314: Dabai, please be polite (..la) Dabai jumped around the office, pointing at Pei Qingyun and gnashing his teeth.
If he hadn't reacted quickly just now, he would have almost fallen into a septic tank.
This is simply the greatest shame in a goose’s life!
Seeing Dabai looking like he was about to eat someone, Chen Xie, who was lying on the sofa, not only did not stop him, but instead sat upright on the sofa.
"Hey, hey! Dabai, what are you doing? Do you have any more rules?"
Chen Xie raised his eyebrows. Although he said scolding words, his tone was full of ill intentions: "Minister Pei Da is a senior executive in our headquarters. He came all the way today just to borrow something from us. You have to be polite to me and don't lose the etiquette of our Seventh Office."
As he said that, Chen Xie showed a bright smile to Pei Qingyun.
But Pei Qingyun felt an inexplicable "thump" in his heart when he saw Chen Xie's smile. His intuition from working at the headquarters all year round told him that this kid was definitely not holding anything back.
"Gah?"
Dabai was stunned and turned his head to look at Chen Xie in disbelief.
"Master Bai, you want me to be polite to this old dog?!"
Dabai pointed at his nose and exclaimed angrily, "He just slapped Master Bai away without even saying hello. Master Bai was already magnanimous without using Gatling to attack him, and he still wants Master Bai to be polite to him?!"
Chen Xie ignored Dabai's complaint, but peeled a grape and threw it into his mouth, and then uttered a sentence leisurely.
"Minister Pei, if you are not the master, I will not lend it to you."
Chen Xie spread his hands and looked at Pei Qingyun with an innocent face, "But the thing you want to borrow is not on my body at all. That thing... is on Dabai's body now. And you just..."
Chen Xie stretched out his voice and glanced at Dabai teasingly, then at Pei Qingyun.
Upon hearing this, Pei Qingyun's hand holding the tea cup suddenly stiffened, and the calmness that had been maintained on his face finally showed a crack.
He looked at Chen Xie in disbelief, then at the dead fat goose, and was completely speechless.
Six Desire Umbrella!
Chen Xie didn't take something so important that could even cause bloodshed in the entire spiritual world with him, but instead put it on a rogue goose who only knew how to eat demon pills and talk about running things every day? !
Dabai was also stunned, and Mung Bean blinked twice.
"Gah? Something? What do you want to borrow?"
Dabai scratched his forehead and suddenly remembered something, "Are you talking about the Six Desire Umbrella?!"
Dabai's exclamation was a disguised admission that the Six Desire Umbrella was on him.
Pei Qingyun's face instantly turned ugly, and he scolded Chen Xie ten thousand times in his heart.
He never thought that when he came to borrow something, the key would be stuck on a goose, and he had just slapped the goose away!
Now it's Dabai's turn to have fun!
"Quack! Hahahaha!"
Dabai put his hands on his hips, looked up to the sky and let out a weird villain laugh.
He poked the coffee table in front of Pei Qingyun and taunted him in a weird way.
"Yo yo yo ~ It turns out that the aloof Minister Pei Da is asking for help from Master Bai today!"
Dabai's face was full of villain success, "Pei, when you showed off your power and slapped Master Bai out just now, did you ever think that there would be such an ending?!"
Dabai raised his chin: "Do you know how to beg Master Bai now? It's too late! Where's that arrogance just now? Keep on slapping. If you have the ability, try slapping Master Bai again!"
Seeing the way Dabai slapped his nose and face, Pei Qingyun took a deep breath and suppressed the urge in his heart to slap him away again.
He simply ignored Dabai's strange anger, turned to look at Chen Xie who was lying on the sofa, and asked with furrowed brows.
"Chen Xie, you are so stupidThere must be a limit to making trouble! How could you let Damax hold such an important thing so carelessly? ! "
